usageGuidelines: Join returned rows to mNAV data by source_date or nearest prior source_date.
Do not use one latest ATLAS row as a proxy for the full history.
Use deltasignal_covenant_stress when only the latest single-issuer detail is needed.

description: Use this read-only tool to retrieve a historical ATLAS-7 covenant and stress series for one crypto public company ticker. It returns one compact row per ATLAS source_date, including debt, crypto fair value, BTC holdings, stress, risk tier, live-price fields, quality flags, and provenance needed for mNAV and Mirror Pulse joins. Parameters: ticker is required; source_date_from and source_date_to bound the inclusive ATLAS source-date range; limit defaults to 500 and is capped at 2000; offset paginates the dated series. Behavior: read-only and idempotent; it performs one HTTPS read, has no destructive side effects, and does not apply the latest ATLAS snapshot retroactively across history. Use this when the user needs historical ATLAS data, MSTR/Strategy time series, mNAV backtests, Mirror Pulse joins, or dated stress/risk snapshots.

limit.description: Maximum dated rows to return. Defaults to 500 and is capped at 2000.

offset.description: Pagination offset over dated ATLAS rows.

source_date_from.description: Optional inclusive ATLAS source-date lower bound in YYYY-MM-DD format.

source_date_to.description: Optional inclusive ATLAS source-date upper bound in YYYY-MM-DD format.

ticker.description: Required crypto public company ticker. Examples: MSTR, COIN, MARA, RIOT.
